name: const unsafe fn read_unaligned (self) -> T where T : Sized ,
rule: If T is not Copy, using both the returned value and the value at self can violate memory safety because read_unaligned creates a bitwise copy; callers must avoid such unsafe duplicate use.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < T > { const unsafe fn read_unaligned (self) -> T where T : Sized , }
